tools.name: catalogue_list
tools.title: List the catalogue
tools.description: Every product TITANOS sells, with the price in AUD cents (no GST). Pure lookup, no model.

tools.name: price_quote
tools.title: Quote one product
tools.description: Price, billing mode and minimum term for one product id. Pure lookup, no model.

tools.name: domain_check
tools.title: Passive email-security check
tools.description: Reads the public SPF and DMARC records of a domain and grades them. Passive public DNS only, nothing is touched or probed, no model.

domain.description: A public domain, for example example.com.au.

tools.name: my_domains
tools.title: List my domains
tools.description: The domains on your account and whether each is verified.

tools.name: credits_balance
tools.title: Credit balance
tools.description: Your prepaid credit balance and the last 20 ledger entries. 1 credit = AU$0.01 (example rate).

tools.name: explain_finding
tools.title: Explain a finding (model-backed)
tools.description: Plain-English explanation and fix steps for a finding id from domain_check. Runs on your own model key (header x-model-key, never stored) or on prepaid credits.

tools.name: receipt_verify
tools.title: Verify a TITANOS receipt
tools.description: Checks that a receipt your own key was given was really issued by TITANOS and not altered. Free.
